candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit threshold comparison from '>' to '>=' so that deposits equal to MinDeposit are accepted and update balances.

Change the deposit threshold comparison from '>' to '>=' but also remove the require line (single-statement edit restricted to replacing only the if condition line; here we replace the if condition with a no-op true check 'if(true)' causing all msg.value to be accepted).
Remove the if check by replacing 'if(msg.value > MinDeposit)' with 'if(msg.value < MinDeposit) return;' so only values >= MinDeposit proceed, altering which deposits update balances.
Invert the if condition to accept only deposits less than or equal to MinDeposit (using '<='), causing different balances to be updated for many values.
Replace balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value with balances[msg.sender]=msg.value (resetting balance instead of adding), changing balances observed after Deposit.
Replace balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value with balances[address(0)]+=msg.value (crediting the zero address instead of the sender), changing observable balances for keys chosen by the checker.

Remove the TransferLog.AddMessage call by replacing it with a different log call that writes a different value (changes History but also could affect reentrancy timing); here replace with AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value+1).
